name: Bomb Throw
description:
Average Action
Effective Range: 3 units
Maximum Range: 6 units
Throw a bomb at target location. If you throw the bomb within the effective range, it lands in place. If you throw it between the effective and maximum range, roll Bomb Throw. The threshold is 2. On failure, the bomb lands in another location within range. The GM can choose the location or roll for a random result.
Follow the bomb's description for its effects and area when it lands.
If an enemy is within 1 unit of you, the effective range is 1, and the maximum range is equal to your normal effective range.

name: Charge
description:
Average Action ◆ Uses movement
Double your Movement score for this round and move to the chosen enemy. You must finish your movement in a place where that enemy is within your melee reach. Then, perform a Melee Strike or Unarmed Strike on that enemy.
Even if moving to your enemy is no longer possible when your action resolves, you must move as close as possible.

name: Grapple
description:
Fast Action
You grapple an enemy that is adjacent to you. Roll Unarmed against Deflection or Fortitude, whichever is higher. The target’s size must be up to one size larger than you. On success, you grapple the target. See the "Glossary" chapter for grappling rules.

name: Weapon Throw
description:
Average Action
Using a weapon with the “thrown weapon” property, throw the weapon at a target within range.
Roll Weapon Throw against Deflection.
On success, deal SD damage. On failure, deal half as much damage, rounded down.
The damage type is appropriate to the weapon.
Modifiers:
You gain disadvantage on the roll if you are within melee reach of an enemy
You gain disadvantage if the range of the attack is higher than the weapon’s effective range (you cannot throw further than the maximum range).

name: Holy Smite
description: Perform a Melee Strike. You get 2 Extra Dice on that roll, or 4 Extra Dice if the target is an Undead or a Demon. The damage type becomes Radiant. You may perform Holy Smite more than once in the same combat by spending 2 devotion points for each additional time.

name: Pinning Shot
description: Perform a Ranged strike. On a successful hit, reduce the target’s Movement score by 2 until the end of the round.

name: Puncturing Shot
description: Perform a Ranged Strike. On a successful hit, the target is Breached 1 (it gets -1 Deflection) until the end of the next round.

name: Ram
description: Perform a Charge using Unarmed Strike with 2 Extra Dice. If you moved at least 2 units towards the enemy, it is force-pushed 1 unit away from you and knocked Prone if it's up to one size larger than you.

name: Aggressive Grapple
description: Perform a Grapple (rolling Unarmed). On success, also deal SD Crushing damage. On failure, deal half as much damage, rounded down, without grappling the target.

name: Enraged Toss
description: Perform a Weapon Throw. Throwing between the effective range and the maximum range of the weapon doesn't cause disadvantage. If you are grappling a creature that's up to one size smaller than you, you may throw it instead of your weapon. It counts as a weapon with a range of 2/4 that deals SD damage. On a successful hit, the creature you threw takes half the damage of the attack, rounded down, and is Prone.

name: Vile Slash
description: Perform a Melee Strike. Gain 2 Extra Dice on the roll, or 4 Extra Dice against a fiend or abomination. The strike's damage type becomes Necrotic or Acid (your choice).

name: Whirlwind
description: Spend 5 Rage to perform a Melee Strike against every enemy within your melee range. Roll Melee once and compare the result against each target's Deflection. Apply your normal Melee Strike damage and effects to each target: full damage on success, or half as much damage on failure, rounded down. If you roll a Double 6, apply your usual Melee Strike Double 6 effects to each target, regardless of whether the roll succeeds against it.
summary: Fast Action · Costs 5 Rage · Range: Melee

name: Power Shot
description: While deployed, spend 1 AP to perform a Ranged Strike. Double the Extra Dice granted by your weapon for this roll.

name: Bomb Slinging
description: While deployed, perform a Bomb Throw with an effective range of 6 units and a maximum range of 12 units. For this action, treat your Bomb Throw skill as Expert (5d6), unless your skill level is already higher.

name: Caltrops
description: While deployed, spend 1 AP to scatter caltrops throughout a 2-unit radius centered on yourself. The area becomes difficult terrain. Once per turn, when a creature first moves within or enters the area during the round, it must roll Acrobatics against threshold 2. On failure, it takes 1 Piercing damage.

name: Multishot
description: Spend 1 AP to perform a Ranged Strike against two enemies using the same roll. You deal half your normal Ranged Strike damage to each target, rounded up.

name: Prayer
summary: Cost: 1 / Combat · Range: 20 Units · Speed: Fast · Costs Faith
description:
Choose a Prayer option. You must spend its required associated Faith cost to perform it.
Domain Weapons (1 Faith): Until the end of the next round, party members may replace Strike damage with Radiant or your domain damage and gain 2 Extra Dice against your domain’s opposition.
Martial Guidance (2 Faith): Party members gain advantage on all attacks until the end of the round.
Guarding Light (2 Faith): Attacks against party members have disadvantage until the end of the round.

name: Sliding Shot
summary: Cost: 1 / Combat · Speed: Fast · Uses movement
description: Double your movement for the round and move at least 3 units. Then, if you did, perform a Ranged Strike against a target within 3 units of you. You have advantage for this strike. You then become Prone.

name: Cleave
summary: Cost: 1 Rage · Speed: Fast · Area: Burst 1
description: Roll Melee with a penalty of 2 against Deflection for all creatures within range. On success, deal your standard Melee Strike damage; on failure, deal half as much damage, rounded down. On success, if you roll a double 6, also apply your Melee Strike Double 6 effects.

name: Animal Strike
description: Strike an enemy within melee range. Roll Magic against Deflection. On success, deal SD damage. On failure, deal half as much damage, rounded down. The damage type is appropriate to the animal form (crushing, piercing, or slashing). Apply a penalty of 2 to the roll if you are Small. On success, if you roll a double 6, activate the effect associated with your chosen animal form.

name: Renewal
description: Spend any amount of devotion points. Heal the target for the same amount.

name: Sphere of Protection
summary: Cost: 2 Devotion Points · Speed: Fast · Range: 6 units
description: Choose a creature within range (including yourself). Attacks against them suffer disadvantage until the end of the next two rounds.

name: Fae Dust Cloud
summary: Cost: 1 / Combat · Speed: Fast · Range: Self
description: You sprinkle Fae dust around yourself in a radius of 2 units centered on yourself. Roll Deception against Will against each enemy in the area. Those you succeed against become Disoriented (1 penalty to all rolls) until the end of the next round.

name: Forceful Maneuver
description: Choose a target within one unit of yourself.  If it's an enemy, roll Unarmed against Deflection. On success, you push or pull that target up to 3 units. You may make the push or pull as forceful (if the target is pushed or pulled against a surface, they receive 1 damage. If they are pushed or pulled against another creature, they both receive 1 damage). The target must be up to one size larger than you.

name: Fiery Eruption
description: Spend 8 Rage to unleash flames on every other creature within 2 units of you. You are not affected. Roll Athletics once and compare the result against each target's Deflection. On success, the target takes 2 Fire damage and is force-pushed 1 unit away from you. On failure, it takes half as much damage, rounded down, and is not pushed.

name: Force Arrow
summary: Special / Trick Shot ◆ Average Action ◆ 1 AP (provisional)
description: Spend 1 AP to fire a magical arrow that hits automatically. Roll Ranged without the Extra Dice granted by your weapon, and deal SD Force damage.

name: Exploding Arrow
summary: Special / Trick Shot ◆ Average Action ◆ 2 AP
description: Spend 2 AP to fire an arrow that explodes in a cube measuring 2 units on each side. Roll Ranged once and compare the result against each enemy's Deflection in the area. On success, it takes 2 Fire damage. On failure, it takes half as much damage, rounded down.

name: Thunder Arrow
description: Spend 2 AP to fire an arrow that releases a thunderous blast in a cube measuring 3 units on each side. Roll Ranged once and compare the result against each enemy's Deflection in the area. On success, an enemy of your size or smaller becomes Prone.

name: Unstable Bomb
description: Create the bomb as part of Bomb Throw. When committing, choose Acid or Fire. The effect fills a 3-unit cube. Roll Bomb Throw against each creature’s Deflection; on success, it takes 1 damage of the chosen type.

name: Smoke Bomb
description: Create the bomb as part of Bomb Throw. The effect fills a 3-unit cube with purple smoke. Creatures inside cannot see outside and have Half Cover against ranged attacks.
